mapper.sql: c.*, s.name AS store_name, s.currency, COALESCE(g.cnt, 0) AS ad_group_count, COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AS target_count, CASE WHEN sc.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_schedule

JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = c.store_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecom_ad_group GROUP BY campaign_id) g ON g.campaign_id = c.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecom_ad_target WHERE target_type <> 'NEGATIVE' GROUP BY campaign_id) t ON t.campaign_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ecom_ad_schedule sc ON sc.campaign_id = c.id AND sc.status = 1
